name: Azeroth Veyrath
description: Knight of the Emperor. Azeroth Veyrath is a spectral conqueror forged from the legacy of fallen kings — each victory stacks imperial power until its Emperor's Judgment Lance obliterates all who dare oppose it.

ability.name: Imperial Conquest
ability.description: Every successful win grants 1 Conquest Stack (max 10). Each stack: +4% ATK, +2% Crit Rate.

chain._note: Imperial Conquest: +4% ATK per win stack, up to 10 stacks

special_move.name: Emperor's Judgment Lance
special_move.description: Veyrath summons spectral weapons from fallen kings and launches them at the enemy in a devastating barrage.
flavour_texts: 👑 **EMPEROR'S JUDGMENT LANCE** — the spectral weapons of fallen kings converge into one divine strike — ALL DEFENSES SHATTERED!
